'''Den''' was a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was stationed as an employee of [[Premier Provisions]], a [[Farm/Legends|farming]] operation on the planet [[Tyed Kant]].
